subject: Interview scheduling confusion — Backend Engineer (loop)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@gmail.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-28T13:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interview: Backend Engineer — 45m video (please confirm timezone)

Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for taking the time. This is a reminder for your interview loop tomorrow: 45 minutes with our backend team (panel: Markus, Mina). Calendar event is scheduled for 2028-05-29 18:00 PDT / 21:00 EDT.

Quick ask: can you confirm you see the slot as 6:00pm Pacific? We had a candidate in another loop confuse PDT/EDT earlier this week and want to make sure there's no timezone mix-up. Joining link is in the calendar invite (attached).

If that time doesn't work, let us know and we can propose two alternate windows tomorrow morning or the following day.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference

Attachment: calendar-invite.ics (event invite stub)

From: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@gmail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Samarit Recruiting <samarit@talentco.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T07:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interview: Backend Engineer — 45m video (please confirm timezone)

Hi Jordan —

Apologies — I only just noticed the invite. I had it in my head as 9:00am local (which is 9:00am PDT) — I missed that it was scheduled for 6:00pm PDT. I can try to make the 6:00pm slot if it's still okay, but I have a hard stop at 18:45 for another commitment.

If that doesn't work, can we please move to a morning slot tomorrow? I'm generally available between 08:30–11:30 PDT. Happy to do a take-home if that is easier.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Liu
(he/him)
Resume attached if useful.

Attachment: ethan_liu_resume.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Samarit Recruiting <samarit@talentco.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Interview: Backend Engineer — candidate timezone confusion / missed join

Team —

Ethan was able to message earlier and said he might join but had a hard stop at 18:45. He did not appear in the room at 18:00. I left an open meeting link for 30 minutes and waited; no join. Samarit says they pinged him at 18:02 but no response after that.

Options I recommend (pick one):
- Option A (fastest to decision): Convert today's loop into a take-home exercise (attached instructions) and ask Ethan to return a solution within 24 hours. We can do an async review and have Markus/ Mina leave bullet notes in the evaluation doc.
- Option B (live): Offer two morning windows tomorrow (08:30–09:30 PDT or 10:30–11:30 PDT) and prioritize a compressed 30-minute interview with core infra questions.
- Option C: Reschedule full loop next week (more candidate friction).

Given the late hour and that a few members have tight calendars tomorrow, I'm leaning Option A to keep momentum. Markus, Mina — any strong preference? If we go take-home, I'll send Ethan the instructions and extend 24 hours.

Monica
Talent Operations

Attachment: takehome-instructions.md

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T18:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Interview: Backend Engineer — candidate timezone confusion / missed join

Monica —

I support Option A (take-home). Two reasons: 1) preserves interviewer bandwidth tonight, 2) gives Ethan a fair chance to demonstrate design and coding without time pressure. If we do that, I can commit to reviewing and leaving notes within 12 hours of submission.

One ask: keep the task limited to ~90 minutes so we set expectations. If he submits something longer, we'll still review, but we'll grade against the timebox.

-Markus
Staff Backend Engineer

PS: Happy to hop on a 30m async discussion if needed, but take-home is my pick.

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T18:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Interview: Backend Engineer — candidate timezone confusion / missed join

I agree with Markus. Also: if Ethan prefers live, I can offer a 30-minute slot tomorrow at 09:00–09:30 PDT (I'll block my calendar) — here's the Calendly link in case he wants to self-book: https://calendly.com/redwood-interviews/30min

Otherwise Monica, please send the take-home with the 24-hour window and a note about the expected ~90-minute timebox. I'll add a short rubric for my portion of the review.

Thanks,
Mina

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@gmail.com>, Samarit Recruiting <samarit@talentco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T18:40:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps after missed loop — please pick an option

Hi Ethan —

Sorry for the confusion this evening and for the missed connection. We want to be flexible — here are two options, please reply with your preference by EOD so we can keep things moving: 

Option 1 — Live (short): 30-minute focused call tomorrow at 09:00–09:30 PDT. If that works, you can book directly here: https://calendly.com/redwood-interviews/30min

Option 2 — Take-home (recommended): A short take-home exercise (expected ~90 minutes). If you pick this, please submit within 24 hours of receiving the instructions (we'll provide a rubric). Attachment includes the instructions and a sample rubric.

We appreciate the flexibility — whichever you pick, we'll make sure the interview experience is fair. If neither option works, tell us two windows that do and we'll reschedule the full loop.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Talent Partner — Redwood Inference

Attachments: takehome-instructions.md, ethan_liu_resume.pdf, calendar-invite.ics
